A simple notice about waiting areas
It is for guests

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers should use the waiting areas that are marked for companion animal check-in, so pets and owners can move through the terminal in a calm way. Please keep leads short, keep carriers closed, and stay close to the desk team when you arrive.

The welcome team will guide you to the right place and help with the next steps before boarding. <<FACT F028>> If a traveler is worried about a pet's comfort or movement, the supervisors will listen carefully and give steady support. This helps us keep the process orderly for all guests and animals.

Please keep personal items together, follow the signs, and wait for updates from staff rather than moving off on your own. If you need help with a carrier, a document check, or a concern about your pet, come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance.
